title: KOF95 native ROM startup
summary: Preserve SAROO bus timing and load the companion ROM through native startup.
rationale: Optional exact-source profile. Apply the three inherited MM.BIN edits as sectors load, then use the existing checked 2 MiB SOR1 handoff. Preserve native file loading and the European disc-change rejection. The former IP helper was overwritten by MM.BIN before entry.

writes.effect: Share the BIOS-pointer literal, relocate IMS and route the native entry tail through the generic ROM handoff.
writes.reason: Keep the original loader and BIOS return delay slot; finish with a NOP-delayed jump instead of a RAM patch writer.

writes.effect: Omit the ASR0 write in native MM code.
writes.reason: Retain the upstream SAROO bus-timing correction at its original instruction.

writes.effect: Skip the native cartridge-check call and its PR-saving delay slot.
writes.reason: Match the upstream startup behavior while the verified companion ROM awaits the generic handoff.
